_note: Departments and positions for the form and CSV. `scoped: true` positions belong to a department and render as "{department} {label}"; board positions ignore department. Bullets may use {department}. Replace any TODO before sending letters. Optional per position: `titleWithDepartment: false` (letter says "Core Member" not "Technical Core Member"), and `closing: { <type>: [paragraphs] }` to replace copy.json's closing for that letter type.

positions.label: President
bullets: Defining the vision and long-term goals of the club.
Overseeing all teams and ensuring harmony among Leads, Co-Leads and members.
Representing the club at official forums, collaborations and institutional events.
Driving innovation and growth so every initiative reflects the spirit of SDC.
positions.closingLine: We are confident you will guide the club to greater heights.

positions.label: Vice President
positions.listIntro: As Vice President, your responsibilities include:
bullets: Supporting the President in all strategic decisions and initiatives.
Acting as a bridge between the executive leadership and team Leads.
Guiding major projects, collaborations and club-wide events.
Acting as President in the President's absence.
positions.closingLine: We trust you to lead from the front and keep the club running smoothly.

positions.label: General Secretary
positions.listIntro: As General Secretary, your responsibilities include:
bullets: Maintaining records of meetings, decisions and key activities.
Coordinating communication between members, Leads and faculty.
Assisting in event planning, correspondence and reporting.
Ensuring smooth internal operations and accountability.
positions.closingLine: We are confident your work will keep the club running with clarity.

positions.label: Operations Lead
positions.listIntro: As Operations Lead, your responsibilities include:
bullets: Overseeing the smooth execution of all events and activities.
Coordinating across teams so that deadlines and goals are met.
Managing resources, schedules and logistics for club initiatives.
Helping the leadership translate plans into action.
positions.closingLine: We look forward to your impact on how the club delivers.

positions.label: Financial Lead
positions.listIntro: As Financial Lead, your responsibilities include:
bullets: Managing the club's budget: forecasting, allocation and tracking of spend.
Overseeing all financial transactions, from sponsorships to event funds.
Maintaining accurate and transparent records for reporting and audit.
Advising the leadership on the feasibility of its initiatives.
positions.closingLine: We trust you to keep the club on a sound financial footing.

positions.label: Lead
positions.listIntro: As a Lead, your responsibilities include:
bullets: Leading and managing the {department} domain.
Setting goals and ensuring smooth execution of projects and events.
Mentoring and giving direction to Co-Leads and core members.
Aligning your team's vision with the club's overall mission.
positions.closingLine: We look forward to seeing you and your team thrive this session.

positions.label: Co-Lead
positions.listIntro: As a Co-Lead, you will work alongside your Lead to:
bullets: Support the planning, execution and monitoring of projects and events.
Mentor and guide core members within your team.
Foster collaboration, creativity and innovation.
Serve as a bridge between the team and the club's leadership.
positions.closingLine: We trust your dedication and leadership will inspire others.

positions.label: Core Member
positions.listIntro: As a Core Member, you will be an integral part of the club’s functioning and growth. Your role will involve:
bullets: Actively contributing to your respective department ({department}).
Supporting your Leads and Co-Leads in executing projects, events, and initiatives.
Bringing creativity, teamwork, and dedication to every task you undertake.
Continuously learning, improving your skills, and taking ownership of your contributions.
positions.closingLine: We look forward to the value you bring to the team.

appointment: This position is not just about responsibility but about growth. As a core member, you are the foundation of the club — the driving force behind every success we achieve. We believe your energy and enthusiasm will make a lasting impact.
We look forward to working with you and witnessing the value you bring to the team. Wishing you an exciting and fulfilling journey ahead.
